postings.title: Account Executive - Canada
postings.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Commercial Account Executive, you will be tasked with owning the full mid-market sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to demonstrations and final negotiations, to consistently exceed revenue quotas. You will strategically partner with resellers and channel managers to execute GTM strategies and accelerate new logo acquisition. By developing deep platform expertise and building C-level relationships, you will act as a trusted advisor, prioritizing customer needs to drive long-term success.

This role supports Ontario, Canada and requires the individual to be based in the region.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Drive revenue growth across your assigned territory through a mix of inbound leads, outbound prospecting, and partner-driven opportunities.

- Own the full sales cycle, from discovery to demo to negotiation to close.

- Build and expand strong relationships with customers, prospects, and partners.

- Collaborate closely with our channel managers and field sales team to create and execute joint go-to-market strategies.

- Partner with our world-class reseller ecosystem to accelerate new logo acquisition and grow recurring revenue.

- Become a product expert in SentinelOne's cybersecurity platform and stay up to date on the broader market landscape.

- Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene and provide reliable forecasts to leadership.

- Represent SentinelOne with professionalism, empathy, and insight, always putting the customer first.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 4 or more years of success in a high-tech cybersecurity sales role.

- A track record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota.

- Experience selling to mid-market or commercial accounts.

- Ability to navigate complex sales cycles and build trust with C-level decision makers.

- Strong collaboration skills and a desire to work cross-functionally with internal teams and partners.

- Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal, and presentation.

- Highly motivated self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

- A commitment to doing what is right for the customer and your teammates.

- Experience working with channel partners or resellers.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Paid time off

- Paid company holidays

- Paid sick leave

- Gender-neutral parental leave

- Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage

- Retirement plan match

- Life and disability insurance

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance

- Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Wellness coach

This U.S. role has a base pay range plus commissions that will vary based on the location of the candidate. The range posted here is the on-target earnings (OTE) for this position, inclusive of base salary and commissions. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

As an Account Executive, SMB at SentinelOne, you own the full sales cycle into organizations of 51 to 500 employees. You bring relevant sales experience and a track record in cybersecurity or SaaS, and you have closed significant deals and exceeded revenue targets before. In this role you build strong proficiency in SMB territory management and sales. Navigating the partner community is essential, and your deepening understanding of cybersecurity, deal structure, customer management, and territory specifics becomes a real asset.

This role covers a Northern territory, and could include metro areas such as Chicago, Boston or New York.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Drive revenue across your territory through a mix of outbound prospecting, and partner-sourced opportunities.

- Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, demonstration, negotiation, and close.

- Create, maintain, and execute a territory plan, and learn to scale your coverage through the channel.

- Work with channel managers, resellers, and the field sales team on joint go-to-market plans that accelerate new logo acquisition.

- Prepare for every engagement, internal and external, and organize your effort around hitting and exceeding quota.

- Forecast to within 10% of your initial call, deliver an accurate weekly commit, and break key deals out in Clari by quarter and month. No hidden deals.

- Present the SentinelOne sales deck with confidence, and structure calls around what you heard, the problem you are solving, MEDDPICC, and the proposed solution.

- Prepare, lead, and present to C-Level buyers and below, and pull in leadership when the audience calls for it.

- Build product and industry knowledge as you ramp, and keep current on threats, competitors, and the SentinelOne platform.

- Respond quickly to internal and external requests, and deliver on what you promised.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 2 to 3 years of successful sales performance at SentinelOne or a comparable or more complex cybersecurity company, hitting and over-achieving quota in a segment equal to or greater than SMB.

- General industry understanding and high-level product knowledge. You know what endpoint security is and what it is for. Deeper expertise is welcome but not required; you will learn the products and the industry as you onboard.

- Channel network or reseller experience is a plus.

- Some experience creating, maintaining, and executing a territory plan.

- Proven ability to convert intent into result through deliberate action.

- Open and ready to learn, able to take honest feedback, and eager to work with leadership and peers.

- Proactive, communicative, and solution-oriented when something is not working for you or your teammates.

- Professional, driven, collaborative, and honest. You look out for your peers.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

- Proficiency with Salesforce, Clari, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Salesloft.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off

- Paid company holidays and paid sick time

- Gender-neutral parental leave

- Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Life and disability insurance

- Health and dependent care FSA

- Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

- ARAG pre-paid legal

- Nationwide pet insurance

- Cancer Care program

- Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Home office allowance

- Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Wellness coach

- Wellness/gym reimbursement

As an Assistant General Counsel, you will work closely with our sales and partnerships teams across all levels of the organization. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Key responsibilities include negotiating customer contracts, channel agreements, strategic partnerships, and ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Take full ownership of commercial legal matters and strategic initiatives from start to finish, rather than managing only specific tasks within a deal.

- Negotiate complex, high-value agreements with customers, channel partners, strategic partners, and other key stakeholders.

- Lead senior-level commercial and legal discussions, representing Legal in executive-facing interactions and contributing to broader business strategy.

- Provide business-savvy, solution-oriented legal advice on a wide range of issues including commercial transactions, privacy, regulatory, and compliance matters.

- Exercise sound judgment in applying and adapting legal playbooks, including where deviations are appropriate based on risk analysis as allowed.

- Partner closely with revenue operations, sales operations, deal desk, product, privacy, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with internal policies and risk thresholds.

- Drive internal legal initiatives and lead cross-functional projects, including process improvements, training programs, and policy development.

- Support, mentor, and help train junior legal team members and new hires, contributing to the growth and maturity of the legal function.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Minimum of 10+ years combined experience at a law firm and in-house at a global company drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, including good working knowledge of SaaS agreements, technology licensing, strategic deals, and channel agreements (such as resellers, distribution, MSP, etc.). SaaS commercial experience is highly desired. Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.

- J.D or an equivalent degree from an accredited law school.

- Active license to practice law in the United States.

- Good understanding of data protection laws (including GDPR) and experience negotiating DPAs, including CIPP certification, is a plus.

- Ability to work independently, set priorities, meet deadlines, and resolve complex problems with a thorough understanding of the changing legal needs in a fast-growing business environment

- Organizational skills and ability to prioritize and work independently and willingness to be flexible and adaptive in a highly dynamic environment

By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As the AVP, Revenue Operations, you will be tasked with building and leading the global operating model for Channel and Partner Operations, Sales Compensation, Renewals Operations, and Quote-to-Cash, turning a complex, multi-motion go-to-market into a scalable, well-governed operation that keeps pace with our growth. Leading a team of regional and operational leaders, you will set the operating cadence, planning, and executive reporting that give Sales, Finance, and the Board a consistent view of the business. You will also shape how we scale through what comes next, from integrating acquisitions and launching new pricing to applying AI and automation across revenue workflows.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Operating cadence and planning: own global forecasting, QBRs, and performance metrics across segments and regions, and lead annual planning for priorities, initiative roadmaps, territory design, and headcount allocation.

- Operating model and team: set the strategy, governance, and performance framework for Channel and Partner Operations, Sales Compensation, Renewals Operations, and quote-to-cash globally, and lead a team of Directors who act as strategic partners to the business, with an org design that scales alongside GTM growth.

- Channel, Partner, and MSSP Operations: scale Deal Registration, Partner SPIFF payments, Partner Activation, co-sell tracking, sourced versus influenced analytics, and the Partner Portal, with automated, standardized processes that support our MSSP program and consumption motions.

- Sales Compensation: drive the annual incentive design cycle (spend analysis, plan design, scenario modeling, communication, and enablement), own all GTM SPIFFs and special incentive programs, and serve as the executive point of contact for Sales leadership on compensation.

- Quote-to-cash and Order Operations: own the quote, order, and booking process end to end, including quoting standards, approval workflows, deal desk escalation, and quarter-end order accuracy, and govern non-standard commercial terms with Finance and Legal.

- Renewals: partner with Global Renewals Sales to scale operations and improve GRR and NRR through aligned process, data, and inspection.

- Executive reporting: own executive and Board reporting for your functions, with consistent metric definitions and narrative quarter over quarter.

- AI and automation: prioritize and manage a portfolio of use cases across these functions, with guardrails set alongside Legal, Security, and Data, and measured adoption and impact.

- M&A integration: lead the operational and systems integration of acquisitions, consolidating partner programs, compensation structures, renewal motions, quoting, and reporting on a clear timeline.

- Readiness and change management: prepare systems, partners, and the Field for product launches, pricing and packaging changes, program redesigns, and international expansion, with the enablement needed to make new processes stick.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 12+ years supporting Sales in an operations capacity, with broad experience across Channel and Partner Operations, Renewals Operations, Sales Compensation, and quote-to-cash.

- 5+ years leading leaders, managing Directors and Managers across multiple functions and geographies, with a track record of building and developing teams.

- High-tech industry experience is required, including Global Enterprise, SMB, and MSSP go-to-market motions through indirect Partner pathways, and SaaS subscription, MSSP billing, and consumption business models.

- Working knowledge of quote-to-cash mechanics, including CPQ, approval and discounting governance, order management, and handoffs into billing and revenue recognition.

- Proven ability to build an operating model and cadence, not just run existing processes, and to translate strategy into measurable business outcomes.

- Experience owning or governing a revenue data model and metric definitions, with systems and reporting held to an executive standard of accuracy.

- Practical experience applying AI and automation to revenue operations workflows, with the judgment to separate real leverage from novelty.

- Experience leading M&A integration or other large-scale transformation, such as systems migrations, program consolidation, or post-acquisition GTM alignment.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics; MBA a plus.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Salesforce, CPQ, Partner Portal applications, Clari, and Excel modeling; experience with NetSuite, incentive compensation platforms, and analytics tools such as Tableau a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a DFIR Analyst, you will be tasked with delivering rapid, expert breach response for global enterprises facing active cyber threats as part of SentinelOne's Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) team, which operates 24x7x365 on a follow-the-sun model. Working under the direction of an investigation's Technical Lead and Engagement Manager, you will execute hands-on forensic analysis, threat hunting, and investigative work across live incidents spanning endpoint, network, and cloud environments, and incident types from ransomware and business email compromise to identity compromise, zero-day exploitation, APT activity, and cloud/SaaS breaches. This is a foundational technical role built on rigor, where every conclusion must be evidence-backed, every case well-documented, and every finding able to hold up to scrutiny.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Conduct EDR-driven incident response and vendor-agnostic forensic analysis spanning endpoint, network, cloud, and SaaS environments, including ransomware, business email compromise, identity compromise, and other common incident types.

- Support malware and memory analysis tasks under the guidance of senior team members.

- Acquire and preserve forensic evidence from endpoint, network, and cloud sources, following standard chain-of-custody procedures.

- Support case intake by gathering initial technical details to assess scope, and support incident containment actions and security hardening recommendations.

- Maintain thorough case documentation throughout each investigation.

- Follow standard operating procedures and escalate technical or logistical questions to the assigned Technical Lead or Engagement Manager as needed.

- Contribute to customer-facing status updates, formal investigative reports, and handovers of investigations across regions as needed, distilling complex technical findings for stakeholders.

- Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attacker techniques, and evolving cybersecurity trends, and contribute observed techniques and indicators to the team's shared knowledge base.

- Be responsive to high-pressure triage and analysis during large-scale cybersecurity incidents, maintaining composure.

- Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for weekends and holidays.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- A bachelor's or master's degree in Digital Forensics, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical self-study, plus 2 or more years of hands-on experience in digital forensics, incident response, or threat hunting, ideally in a consulting or services delivery environment.

- Comfort analyzing Windows environments and forensic artifacts, with a foundational understanding of forensic methodologies, evidence handling, acquisition techniques, and chain-of-custody procedures.

- Experience with forensic tools such as X-Ways Forensics, Axiom, and FTK; with EDR/XDR platforms (SentinelOne preferred) and SIEMs; and working knowledge of network protocols and network-based forensic analysis.

- Scripting and automation capabilities.

- Strong verbal and written communication, with comfort documenting and presenting technical findings clearly and precisely.

- Ability to perform technical investigations under pressure in high-stakes, time-sensitive situations, while maintaining composure.

- An evident self-starter with intellectual curiosity and the ability to adapt to change.

- Knowledge of Linux and macOS forensic analysis, exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and memory analysis, and foundational experience conducting malware analysis and understanding the reverse engineering process are preferred.

- Familiarity with endpoint threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence platforms, the MITRE ATT&CK framework, and AI-assisted tools for streamlining triage, analysis, or reporting workflows is preferred.

- Relevant industry certifications, such as GCFE, GCFA, GREM, CFCE, or EnCE, and interest in contributing to industry publications, research, or speaking engagements are preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

- Performance-based bonus

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off, on top of the standard 5 weeks PTO

- Paid company wellness days and fully paid short-term sick/nursing leave

- Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Private medical care benefit

- Life and disability insurance

- Pension Insurance contribution

- Global business travel medical insurance

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance

- Meal allowance

- Hybrid work in Prague (Karlin), Brno (Clubco) or remote in CZ/SK. Only Prague-based employees are required to work from the office at least 2 days//week.

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Wellbeing allowance

- MultiSport benefit program

- Wellness Coach app

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Conduct EDR-driven incident response and vendor-agnostic forensic analysis spanning endpoint, network, cloud, and SaaS environments, including ransomware, business email compromise, identity compromise, and other common incident types.

- Acquire and preserve forensic evidence from endpoint, network, and cloud sources following standard chain-of-custody procedures; support case intake by gathering initial technical details to assess scope.

- Support malware and memory analysis tasks under the guidance of senior team members.

- Support incident containment actions and prepare security hardening recommendations; maintain thorough case documentation throughout each investigation.

- Contribute to customer-facing status updates and formal investigative reports, distilling complex technical findings for stakeholders.

- Follow standard operating procedures and escalate technical or logistical questions to the assigned Technical Lead or Engagement Manager as needed.

- Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attacker techniques, and evolving cybersecurity trends; contribute observed attacker techniques and indicators to the team's shared knowledge base.

- Be responsive to high-pressure triage and analysis during large-scale cybersecurity incidents, maintaining composure; participate in a rotating on-call schedule for weekends and holidays.

- Support handovers of investigations across regions as needed.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Digital Forensics, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical self-study.

- 2 or more years of hands-on experience in digital forensics, incident response, or threat hunting, ideally in a consulting or services delivery environment.

- Comfort analyzing Windows environments and forensic artifacts; foundational understanding of forensic methodologies, evidence handling, acquisition techniques, and chain-of-custody procedures.

- Experience with forensic tools such as X-Ways Forensics, Axiom, and FTK.

- Experience with EDR/XDR platforms (SentinelOne preferred) and SIEMs.

- Working knowledge of network protocols and network-based forensic analysis; scripting and automation capabilities.

- Strong verbal and written communication—comfortable documenting and presenting technical findings clearly and precisely.

- Ability to perform technical investigations under pressure in high-stakes, time-sensitive situations, while maintaining composure; an evident self-starter with intellectual curiosity and the ability to adapt to change.

- Knowledge of Linux and macOS forensic analysis is preferred.

- Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and memory analysis is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Competitive leave benefits

- Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Medical and insurance benefits

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance

- Internet and mobile phone allowance

- Flexible benefits allowance

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

As a Director of User Experience, Purple Autonomous SOC, you will be tasked with defining and scaling the user experience for our Purple Autonomous SOC platform, blending strategic design leadership, UX architecture, and hands-on design excellence. You will operate as a senior player/coach, shaping long-term UX vision while directly influencing high-impact product initiatives, and ensuring that complex, data-rich security products feel coherent, intuitive, and trustworthy for security teams operating in high-stakes environments. You will be accountable for UX quality across multiple product surfaces and for building a design organization capable of operating at scale.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Define and evolve the end-to-end user experience for the Autonomous SOC, rethinking how customers interact with traditional products in a more agent-first experience.

- Establish a cohesive interaction model and information architecture that focuses on agentic actions and the areas where humans need to orchestrate them.

- Own the long-term UX vision and ensure alignment with product management on the strategy.

- Lead system-level design thinking for complex and innovative new interaction models.

- Ensure consistency, scalability, accessibility, and usability across the product ecosystem.

- Lead a high-performing product design organization, managing and mentoring senior managers, lead designers, and principal-level ICs.

- Attract, hire, and retain top design talent, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Threat Research, and Executive Leadership, influencing product strategy through user insights, design vision, and architectural thinking.

- Advocate for design at the leadership level, balancing user needs with technical and business constraints, and communicate design strategy, tradeoffs, and outcomes clearly to executive stakeholders.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 10 or more years of experience in Product Design or UX, with 5 or more years in senior leadership roles.

- Proven experience leading UX for complex B2B or SaaS platforms.

- Strong background in UX architecture, interaction models, and system-level design.

- Strong understanding of agentic automation and how it will impact traditional design models.

- Experience designing cybersecurity, observability, DevOps, or similarly complex technical products is preferred.

- Familiarity with security workflows such as alert triage, investigations, threat hunting, and incident response is preferred.

- Experience defining or evolving enterprise design systems at scale is preferred.

- Experience supporting multi-product or platform-based organizations is preferred.

As a Director, Commercial Sales, you will be tasked with managing a regional team of Commercial Field Account Executives. Success in this role is dependent on the ability to implement and manage an effective sales strategy and operational program and cadence. This includes building strong, productive relationships with prospects, customers, partners, and within the team; recruiting and onboarding new customers; and focusing on growing new business opportunities.

Above all, this is a leadership hire. We are looking for a proven people leader -- someone who has repeatedly made individual sellers better, built and retained teams others want to join, and carried their team through difficult quarters. This role is broad and will require the individual be credible in front of customers alongside their reps, disciplined in inspection, forecasting and reporting, and a capable developer of sales talent. Cybersecurity experience is preferred, however, secondary to demonstrated sales leadership.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Leading and Developing the Team:

- Lead a regional team of Commercial Field Account Executives and own the achievement of your team’s regional quota attainment - measured not only by whether the team hits its number, but by how many of your reps individually hit theirs.

- Coach, guide and lead your team to create our next generation of sales leaders. Develop sellers continuously rather than only in formal reviews, coach to the behavior rather than the outcome, and measure whether it worked.

- Build and retain the team. Recruit, onboard and ramp new talent. Retaining strong people in a competitive market is a core part of this role.

- Set the standard and hold it. Establish what good looks like on this team, model it personally, and expect it from others without requiring escalation to enforce it.

- Running the Business:

- Engage directly in deals. Work alongside your reps on their most significant opportunities, improving the outcome while building the rep’s own capability rather than substituting for it.

- Own the forecast. Produce a forecast your leadership can rely on, supported by disciplined opportunity inspection and an accurate view of pipeline health — including where the underlying data requires validation before it can be trusted.

- Run the operating cadence. Design and maintain a program covering pipeline generation, account and territory planning, and opportunity qualification aligned to MEDDPICC, in which each recurring meeting produces a clear decision and the team’s performance is sustainable without your direct intervention.

- Lead account and territory planning with tactical execution to gain wallet share from existing customers and market share from the competition.

- Establish and maintain key customer and partner relationships, and develop strategies for expanding the company’s customer base within your region.

- Execute as One Team by partnering with Sales Engineering, our Channel organization, Partners, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing and Support to close deals and drive revenue and adoption.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- A demonstrable record of making individual reps measurably better, with specific people and specific outcomes you can describe.

- Experience developing people into larger roles, including promoting from within your own team.

- The ability to coach in the moment - in and immediately after a customer conversation - rather than only in a scheduled review.

- Credibility in front of customers such that reps actively seek your involvement in their most important opportunities, and leave those engagements stronger rather than diminished.

- A track record of hiring well, with a view on how many of your hires are still in seat and how many you would hire again.

- Demonstrated ability to get things done through teams that do not report to you, with enough understanding of their incentives to be worth helping in return.

- The ability to build relationships that cross organizational boundaries, internally and externally, before you need them.

- The ability to communicate, present and influence at all levels of an organization, including executive and C-level.

- Receptiveness to feedback, and the ability to adjust your approach in response to it - or to make a clear, evidence-based case for an alternative view.

- Proven sales management experience, consistently meeting or exceeding targets, and developing client-focused, differentiated and achievable solutions.

- The ability to interpret a complex or imperfect pipeline and commit to a defensible number, with a clear understanding of the distinction between commit, best case and upside.

- Fluency in the underlying sales mathematics - the relationship between activity, pipeline coverage, win rates and attainment - and the ability to explain it without reference to a report.

- Strong attention to detail and comfort working at the individual record and opportunity level, alongside the ability to form a view at portfolio level.

- The ability to build a strategic plan and execute it, delivering expected results, and to prioritize engagement and support in line with the division’s strategic focus.

- Proven experience running an effective operational program and cadence with a focus on pipeline generation and account and opportunity planning, aligned with MEDDPICC opportunity qualification methodology.

- A preference for building repeatable systems over relying on individual effort, and the discipline to hold a standard consistently.

- Persistence that you hold personally and set as an expectation for your team; you do not treat an early objection as a final answer.

- The capacity to manage multiple competing priorities concurrently, and the judgment to sequence them without requiring day-to-day direction.

- Experience working collaboratively with partners and the channel to drive incremental revenue and support partner revenue growth. Existing relationships with channel partners in the region are preferred.

- Excellent listening, organizational, negotiation and presentation skills, with strong oral and written communication.

- Prior experience in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with a growth mindset, technical acumen and a genuine interest in security.

- BA/BS or equivalent experience.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. As a Director, Global MSSP Ecosystem Sales, you will be tasked with owning SentinelOne's Global MSSP Ecosystem Partner Development team, the front line of our largest managed-services route to market, reporting into Managed Services leadership. - Attract, recruit, and onboard top talent to build a skilled MSSP Ecosystem Partner Development team.

- Establish and maintain senior relationships with key partners, with particular focus on our platform-commit tier.

- Develop and implement strategies to expand product adoption across the partner base, including endpoint, identity, data, cloud, and AI SIEM.

- Partner cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Support to reduce churn, close deals, and drive revenue and product adoption.

- 8 or more years in product management at enterprise SaaS or infrastructure companies, including 2 or more years leading and managing other product managers.

As an Integrated Campaign Manager, you will be tasked with owning the strategy behind one of SentinelOne's highest-priority demand generation campaigns. Sitting within the Demand Generation & Campaigns team, this role is the connective tissue between Product Marketing and Regional Leaders (AMER, EMEA & APJ) to develop a cohesive strategy, working with the teams across paid digital, events, webinars, email, and ABM who will execute, and tracking performance through pipeline. It's an ideal role for a marketer who's hands-on, channel-fluent, and driven by pipeline outcomes.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Own the end-to-end integrated campaign strategy, from creative brief through launch, optimization, and reporting.

- Translate Product Marketing positioning and messaging into a cross-channel campaign architecture that connects awareness through pipeline.

- Build and maintain the campaign calendar, managing timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across all internal stakeholders.

- Partner with Campaign Leads and adjacent campaign programs to identify opportunities for cross-campaign synergy or audience overlap.

- Act as the primary point of accountability for campaign performance, owning the KPI dashboard and presenting results to Demand Gen leadership.

- Work with Product Marketing to identify, brief, and activate the campaign content assets needed at each funnel stage.

- Provide messaging feedback and content direction grounded in campaign performance signals and audience insights.

- Jointly plan with partner marketing and sequence partner activation against the core campaign timeline so channel motions reinforce the direct campaign rather than competing with it.

- Partner with regional marketing leaders to adapt the campaign to theater-level realities, managing strategic input, ongoing communication, and joint accountability to KPIs.

- Work with the paid media team on media plans and audience targeting strategies, ensuring paid programs are tightly aligned with ICP and ABM account lists.

- Continuously test, learn, and optimize ad creative, audience targeting, and spend allocation based on performance data.

- Own the audience acquisition, promotion, and follow-up strategy for campaign webinars in collaboration with the Webinars Team.

- Partner with the Email & Lifecycle Marketing Manager to embed the campaign into appropriate nurture tracks and lifecycle journeys.

- Ensure content assets and campaign activations are properly tagged, tracked, and attributable within Salesforce and Tableau.

- Coordinate localization needs for priority markets, and build campaign kits that make regional activation seamless.

- Partner with the ABX team to build account-level targeting lists for the campaign, leveraging 6sense or DemandBase intent signals.

- Coordinate personalized campaign plays for strategic accounts, aligning marketing touchpoints with SDR and sales outreach.

- Track account-level engagement and pipeline influence for ABM-targeted accounts within the campaign.

- Define campaign KPIs and own regular reporting cadences.

- Monitor funnel conversion metrics, and bring optimization recommendations to the team.

- Deliver performance readouts to Demand Gen leadership with clear, data-backed recommendations for budget, channel mix, and creative adjustments.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 3–5 years of B2B marketing experience with a demonstrated focus on integrated campaign management and demand generation.

- Proven track record of taking integrated campaigns to market across multiple channels, including paid digital, events, content/email, and/or ABM.

- Experience working cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Digital, Field Marketing, Content, and Marketing Ops teams.

- Experience marketing in the cybersecurity industry, especially to security operations, or IT/security leadership personas.

- Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms (Marketo and Salesforce); comfort managing campaigns within these systems.

- Strong project management skills; able to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously without dropping the ball.

- Analytical mindset with the ability to read campaign performance data, draw conclusions, and communicate recommendations clearly.

- Excellent written communication skills; able to translate complex technical messaging into crisp, compelling campaign briefs and copy directions.

- Experience operating in a matrixed marketing org with both global strategy and regional execution teams, having built campaigns that regional teams could actually run, and comfortable collaborating across time zones.

- Fluency with AI tools in day-to-day marketing workflow, using them to accelerate research, briefing, analysis, and content iteration.

Nice to have:

- Experience working in a partner-led organization, and familiarity with MSPs/MSSPs, distribution partners, and CSPs.

- Hands-on experience with intent and ABM platforms such as 6sense or DemandBase.

- Familiarity with ABX strategy, including account selection, tiering, and personalized campaign plays.

- Knowledge of multi-touch attribution models and how to accurately tie campaign activities to pipeline in Salesforce.

- Experience building campaigns for multiple markets, including localization and regional adaptation.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off

- Paid company holidays and paid sick time

- Gender-neutral parental leave

- Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Life and disability insurance

- Health and dependent care FSA

- Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

- ARAG pre-paid legal

- Cancer Care program

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

- Wellness coach

- Wellness/gym reimbursement

- Fertility coverage

- Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

As an MSSP Project Manager, you will be tasked with driving project management across SentinelOne's MSSP business, from MSSP product transition strategies to key strategic programs and special projects. You will join a newly formed team supporting MSSP Revenue Acceleration as SentinelOne evolves its MSSP program, working closely with MSSP Revenue Assurance and MSSP Sales Leadership. Partnering across MSSP, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product, Legal, and IT, you will keep timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders aligned so initiatives land on time and with quality.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Track and monitor deliverables for the MSSP product transition strategy, defining key milestones and working cross-functionally to keep project timelines and deliverables on track.

- Provide project management across MSSP revenue operations initiatives, including quote-to-cash, deal governance, forecasting, and partner lifecycle enhancements, in partnership with the MSSP Revenue Assurance team.

- Support ad hoc special projects within MSSP, such as partnering with internal teams to unify capabilities and offerings within MSSP.

- Selectively lead key large and strategic MSSP programs, ensuring timely delivery and quality.

- Build and maintain the project management operating system for MSSP, including project plans, dependency maps, and a status reporting cadence that gives leadership real-time visibility into active initiatives.

- Evaluate and, where needed, suggest processes that anticipate, identify, and mitigate potential issues, and coach teams on risk, dependency, and stakeholder management practices.

- Foster strong cross-functional collaboration across MSSP, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Product, Legal, IT, and other teams, breaking down silos and encouraging open communication.

As a Partner Development Manager on SentinelOne's Global MSSP Ecosystem team, you'll own account management, partner enablement, and partnership support for a defined, named set of MSSP Ecosystem partners — that sell through MSSPs. Unlike the regionally-aligned Partner Development Manager role, your book of business is fixed by name rather than territory, and you'll report into the Director, Global MSSP Ecosystem Sales.

You'll design high-quality, strategic service activation plans for each named partner, growing wallet share and reducing churn within an existing, high-value book rather than recruiting net-new logos. You'll work closely with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Support to design and implement joint go-to-market campaigns, develop strategic business plans, and run a disciplined account planning cadence aligned to MEDDPICC.

Ideal candidates bring prior experience selling full-stack security solutions, expanding product footprint within a fixed set of strategic accounts, executing strategic business plans, and outperforming the market — with a background in high-tech sales and prior experience selling to Service Providers and/or Managed Security Service Providers, ideally including exposure to platform-commit or similarly concentrated partner relationships. This role requires moderate travel (typically 25–50%) to build and sustain in-person relationships with your named partners.

What Will You Do?

- Own and grow a fixed, named portfolio of between 3-10 MSSP Ecosystem partners, serving as the primary business owner of each relationship and building revenue-generating security service offerings with each.

- Develop and execute a strategic business plan for each named partner to manage innovation, collaboration, and the next logical areas for business expansion within the partnership.

- Establish and maintain senior relationships within your named partners, nurturing partner executives and key sales leaders to align priorities across respective field organizations and build a “better together” fly-wheel that holds up against competitive threats.

- Drive new pipeline and revenue through each partner's marketplace or distribution motion, using data to sharpen strategy and tactics and establish competitive advantage for SentinelOne's established and emerging product portfolio.

- Stay current on the SentinelOne competitive landscape and sell the value of our solutions and services relative to competitors.

- Ensure partners receive timely product and MSP/MSSP model updates for each relevant product area, and work with internal teams to build service offerings and develop launch content.

- Drive program management and governance for service offering launches across your named accounts.

- Develop and drive KPI metrics to assess partnership effectiveness, regularly reviewing partner engagement and performance and adjusting strategy as needed — with a demonstrable track record of setting and hitting financial goals with focus partners.

- Ensure each named partner is equipped with the tools and resources to scale their go-to-market and compete effectively, and establish enablement goals that validate partners meet the training, certification, and support requirements of the partner program.

- Evangelize partner service offerings and bring the voice of the partner back into SentinelOne's sales organization.

- Prepare and deliver accurate forecasts of revenue for your named book of business.

- Partner cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Support to reduce churn, close deals, and drive revenue and product adoption.

- Stay aligned with the Director, Global MSSP Ecosystem Sales, and peer Partner Development Managers on forecasting, enablement, and the launch of newly created solutions with your partners.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

- BS technical degree or equivalent work experience.

- 5+ years of above-quota sales experience, preferably as a Regional Sales Executive/Manager selling security solutions across endpoint, identity, data, and cloud.

- Strong partner background across Managed offering providers — MSP, MSSP, MDR, XDR, outsourcers, distribution, and systems integrators.

- Experience managing a concentrated, named book of strategic accounts rather than a broad territory — comfort with fewer, deeper relationships, ideally with a track record of driving double- or triple-digit revenue growth at the partner level.

- Deep knowledge of current security solutions, including indirect/managed sales motions (fully managed, co-managed, single- and two-tier; CSP marketplace experience a plus).

- Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage a variety of technical and business leaders internally and externally, including at the executive level.

- Enterprise sales experience with an actionable network of MSSP decision makers.

- Superb organizational and reporting skills.

- Experience growing the sales enablement function to support sales in a rapidly evolving, competitive marketplace.

- Motivated, focused self-starter with strong leadership skills, able to multitask and work both independently and collaboratively within a team.

- A “whatever it takes” attitude and motivation to deliver above-quota performance.

- Prior startup experience.

- Experience working with channel partners and a strong understanding of partner-centric go-to-market approaches.

- Smart, funny, technical, and passionate about security!

Why us?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Principal AI Developer Experience Architect, you will serve as the technical authority for the AI engineering layer at SentinelOne, designing how enterprise-grade AI coding assistants and LLM platforms integrate into our engineering workflows. You will own the strategy and architecture that ensures AI-generated code is trustworthy, performant, and reliable by default for an 800+ developer organization. Your work will ensure our AI tooling investment is secure, governed, and measurably impactful across context management, prompt design, and AI-driven code review.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

Architect the AI Engineering Layer

- Define the end‑to‑end architecture for AI-augmented development at SentinelOne, centered on enterprise-grade AI coding assistants and LLM platforms integrated with our IDEs, CI/CD pipelines, and internal platforms.

- Design how large-context LLMs consume our codebase and documentation context so that AI assistance scales safely across hundreds of repos.

- Establish reusable patterns for agentic workflows with clear rollback and validation strategies.

Own AI Guardrails, Skills, and Standards

- Define and maintain SentinelOne AI Coding Standards and a global skills & requirements framework that all AI coding tools (our chosen AI coding assistants, PR bots, agents) must enforce, including language, framework, security, performance, and reliability patterns.

- Translate these standards into prompt templates, tool configurations, and policy‑as‑code so they are enforced automatically rather than via documentation alone.

- Partner with InfoSec, Data Governance, and Legal to ensure all AI tooling adheres to SentinelOne’s AI Policies, data residency, and FedRAMP compliance requirements.

Implement AI-Driven Code Review and Safety as Code

- Lead the integration of AI-powered code review tools that use AST analysis and static/dynamic checks to enforce style, security, performance, and reliability standards before human review.

- Integrate AI review signals with our SRE observability stack (logs, metrics, traces) to correlate code changes with incidents and anomalies, closing the loop from PR to production behavior.

- Encode “safety as code” by integrating test coverage, performance scans, and progressive delivery patterns (canaries, blue/green) into AI‑authored change flows.

Lead Vendor Evaluation and Integration

- Serve as the principal technical owner for AI developer tooling evaluations using structured evaluation criteria and data-driven analysis.

- Work closely with the DevEx leadership and TPM to design and run POCs, define technical success criteria, and produce executive‑ready recommendations.

- Ensure all vendors meet SentinelOne’s security, privacy, and data governance standards.

Drive Developer Adoption and Experience

- Act as the technical face of AI DevEx to engineering: publish guidance, patterns, and internal frameworks that make AI tooling a seamless part of everyday work rather than a side experiment.

postings.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Principal Software Engineer, AI SIEM, you will be tasked with reasoning across all three layers of SentinelOne's AI SIEM: how data moves and gets queried at scale, how analysts actually work with what the system surfaces, and how detections get built and tuned. Our AI SIEM ingests petabytes of data per day, powers the analyst workflows that turn that data into alerts, findings, assets, and incidents, and drives the detection engines, both rule-based and AI-driven, that catch what matters. You will look at the system as a whole, find where it's exceptional, where it has gaps, where it has redundant or overlapping effort, and drive the architectural decisions that close those gaps.

This is not a role scoped to one service or one team's backlog. It's for someone who can sit above the individual pillars, understand how they're supposed to fit together, and act when they don't.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Build a working mental model of the full system, including ingest and storage, query and retrieval, analyst-facing workflows (alerts, findings, assets, incidents), and the detection engines (rule-based and beyond), and use it to identify where architecture is solid, where it's fragile, and where teams are unknowingly duplicating effort or leaving gaps between their boundaries.

- Drive cross-team architectural decisions that affect multiple parts of the system at once, for example, how ingest-time enrichment should relate to detection logic, or how detection output should shape what an analyst sees and can act on.

- Partner with the engineering leads of each pillar (data platform, analyst experience, detection engines) as a peer thought partner, not a top-down authority, influencing through technical credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.

- Identify and prioritize the highest-leverage architectural investments across the system, and make the case for them to engineering leadership and product.

- Get hands-on where it matters: prototype, review, and occasionally build the connective tissue between pillars when no single team naturally owns it.

- Establish and champion cross-cutting technical standards, for APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, that keep independently-developed pillars interoperable as they evolve.

- Mentor senior and staff engineers across teams, raising the bar for architectural thinking org-wide, not just within one team.

- Represent the technical health of the overall system in planning and leadership conversations, translating "what's exceptional, what's a gap, what's redundant" into a roadmap.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Deep experience (15 or more years) building and operating large-scale distributed backend systems, with direct experience in at least two of: high-throughput data ingest/storage, query engines, or detection/rules systems.

- A demonstrated track record of reasoning about systems at the architecture level, not just implementing a spec, but identifying where a system's boundaries are wrong, where responsibilities overlap, and where they leave gaps.

- Experience designing APIs and service contracts that need to hold up across teams and years, not just within one codebase.

- Comfort operating without a single clear chain of command, influencing peer teams and senior engineers through the strength of your reasoning.

- A four-year degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

- Familiarity with security operations concepts (alerts, findings, assets, incidents, detection rules) is preferred; if you don't have direct SIEM/XDR background, you should be someone who can get fluent in a new domain fast.

- Experience with modern cloud infrastructure and data-intensive systems (distributed storage, high-cardinality querying, streaming pipelines) is preferred; specific tools matter less than demonstrated judgment about tradeoffs at scale.

- Exposure to both rule-based and ML/AI-driven detection approaches is a plus, but the more important trait is being able to reason about when each is the right tool.

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. - Deploy and configure Prompt Security across enterprise scenarios, including employee AI tool access, developer AI workflows, home-grown AI applications, and browser-based controls via enterprise MDM.

- Advise customers on AI governance, data protection, and policy enforcement, addressing risks such as prompt injection and shadow AI usage.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges during active deployments, escalating appropriately when complex architectural decisions arise.

- Partner with pre-sales teams to scope engagements and provide technical input into Statements of Work (SOWs).

- Work alongside channel partners (MSSPs, system integrators, resellers), providing technical guidance during joint engagements, building their delivery capability over time.

- Contribute to internal and partner-facing delivery documentation, implementation guides, and technical reference materials.

- Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and represent their technical needs internally.

What skills and knowledge should you bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 5 to 8 years of experience in enterprise cybersecurity, with meaningful time in customer-facing technical roles such as Professional Service or security engineering.

- Solid hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR, including deployment, configuration, integration, and migrations from incumbent platforms.

- Good understanding of endpoint telemetry, detection and response workflows, and integration with SIEM, identity, and cloud security platforms.

- Practical experience designing and delivering AI security controls — Prompt Security or a comparable platform.

- Understanding of browser-based AI security deployment via MDM and API-level integration patterns.

- Awareness of AI security risks, including prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, shadow AI, and agentic AI workflows.

- Experience contributing to engagement scoping, effort estimation, and SOW input.

- Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders.

- Experience working alongside channel partners in a delivery or advisory capacity.

- Proficiency across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments (installation, configuration, administration, security best practices).

- Containerization: Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Strong working knowledge of security and network concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, LAN/WAN, firewalls, IDS/IPS, etc.).

- Automation and Scripting: Proficiency with automation tools or scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash).

- Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent).

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

- Performance-based bonus

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off, on top of the standard 5 weeks PTO

- Paid company wellness days and fully paid short-term sick/nursing leave

- Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Private medical care benefit

- Life and disability insurance

- Pension Insurance contribution

- Global business travel medical insurance

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Global home office allowance

- Hybrid work in Prague (Karlin), Brno (Clubco) or remote in CZ/SK. Only Prague-based employees are required to work from the office at least 2 days/week.

- Wellness Coach app

You will operate with moderate guidance on assigned workstreams and apply hands-on IT and cybersecurity knowledge to assess risk accurately and credibly across a diverse vendor portfolio.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Conduct vendor assessments by reviewing questionnaire responses, evaluating SOC 2 reports, and examining supporting technical documentation including penetration test findings, vulnerability disclosures, encryption practices, and access control configurations; identify technical control gaps and contribute to risk-prioritized remediation plans.

- Review and interpret vendor-provided technical documentation including system architecture diagrams, data flow maps, hardening standards, patch management practices, and incident response capabilities with moderate oversight; apply growing knowledge of common IT environments (cloud, SaaS, on-prem, hybrid) to contextualize vendor risk.

- Map vendor technical controls to ISO 27001, SSAE 18/SOC 2, SOX ITGC, GDPR, NIST CSF/SP 800-53, and SentinelOne's internal security policies; deduce general gaps where technical implementation falls short of framework requirements and support closure efforts with vendors.

- Support Vendor Risk Assessment workstreams and project objectives; track remediation activities to completion, validate technical evidence of fixes, and escalate unresolved risk to senior analysts or management with clear business impact framing, with moderate oversight.

- Communicate with IT, Engineering, Legal, and Procurement teams to gather technical context and align on risk tolerance; communicate findings clearly to both technical teams using precise IT and security language and to non-technical stakeholders by translating risk into business impact.

- Stay current on the evolving threat landscape including cloud misconfigurations, supply chain attacks, and third-party data exposure risks, and apply this awareness to refine assessment criteria.

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to automate tasks, query APIs, process data (JSON/CSV), and manage code using Git; apply AI tools enthusiastically to automate workflows and be prepared to share concrete examples of how you have used scripting and AI to automate tasks.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 3 to 5 years of experience in information security, IT risk, vendor/third-party risk management, or GRC, with hands-on experience assessing vendors across a range of technical environments and approximately 75 to 100 vendor assessments completed; prior experience in an IT, systems, or security engineering role is a strong plus.

- Solid and developing understanding of core IT and security domains including network security (firewalls, segmentation, VPNs, DNS), cloud platforms and shared responsibility models (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity and Access Management (SSO, MFA, privileged access), endpoint security and patch and vulnerability management, data protection and encryption (at rest and in transit) and DLP, logging and monitoring and SIEM concepts, and secure SDLC and application security fundamentals.

- Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2 (SSAE 18), NIST CSF/SP 800-53, SOX ITGC, GDPR, and CCPA.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

- Preferred certifications include CISA, CISM, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CCSK, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, or equivalent.

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Services, you will be tasked with taking ownership of our AI Gateway infrastructure (built on Kong AI Gateway), the system that authenticates, routes, rate-limits, and monitors AI coding assistant traffic org-wide, while also being fluent enough across our broader platform stack to design solutions that span the two. This is a high-autonomy, high-scope role: you will set technical direction for AI infrastructure, drive incident response and reliability work, and partner closely with the engineers who own our CI/CD, GitOps, and artifact systems rather than working in isolation from them.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Work on the AI Gateway platform: architect, harden, and scale our Kong AI Gateway deployment (Konnect Hybrid on KCP/EKS), including auth (Okta/OIDC), consumer tiers and budgets, rate limiting, semantic caching, and observability.

- Lead reliability and incident response: drive root-cause analysis and remediation for gateway issues (timeouts, latency, capacity, failover) and build the monitoring/alerting needed to catch them before users do.

- Design across the platform, not just the gateway: work fluently with our CI/CD (Jenkins, JPAAS), GitOps and Kubernetes deployment tooling (ArgoCD across dev/gov/prod), artifact management (Artifactory/Xray), GitHub Enterprise administration, and GitHub Actions runner fleet, so that AI infrastructure decisions account for how the rest of the platform actually works.

- Evaluate and roll out AI developer tooling: run structured pilots and adoption efforts for tools like AI-assisted PR review (Qodo) and engineering metrics platforms (LinearB), and make clear build-vs-buy recommendations.

- Set technical direction and mentor: define architecture and standards for AI infrastructure, review designs across the team, and raise the bar for other engineers working in this space.

- Partner cross-functionally: work directly with security, DevEx, and product engineering teams consuming the gateway to translate their needs into platform capabilities.

- Host and serve local models: stand up and operate self-hosted/open-weight model serving infrastructure (e.g. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama) for workloads where routing to an external provider isn't the right fit, including GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, and cost/performance tuning.

- Support the broader model lifecycle: help build LLMOps practices such as model versioning, evaluation, and safe rollout, plus supporting infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation (vector stores, embedding pipelines) as use cases mature.

- Track usage and cost: build observability into token usage, latency, and spend across both API-based and self-hosted models so the business can see what AI infrastructure actually costs.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 5 or more years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, with a track record of owning systems end-to-end in production.

- Hands-on experience with API gateway technologies (Kong, Envoy, Apigee, or similar); direct experience with AI/LLM gateway patterns (rate limiting, semantic caching, prompt/response observability) is a strong plus.

- Strong Kubernetes and GitOps experience (ArgoCD or comparable), and comfort operating across multiple environments (dev, gov, prod).

- Solid CI/CD background: Jenkins pipeline design and administration, build infrastructure, and runner/agent fleet management (GitHub Actions runners or equivalent).

- Experience with artifact and package management systems (Artifactory, Xray, or similar) and source control platform administration (GitHub Enterprise).

- Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud platforms (AWS/EKS).

- Experience deploying and operating self-hosted LLM inference stacks (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/NIM, TGI, Ollama, or similar) and GPU-backed infrastructure, including Kubernetes GPU scheduling and autoscaling.

- Familiarity with LLMOps practices: model versioning, evaluation harnesses, and usage/cost observability across API-based and self-hosted models.

- Track record of setting technical direction, driving cross-team initiatives, and mentoring other engineers; this role has significant scope and minimal day-to-day oversight.

- Clear, proactive communicator who can explain infrastructure trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience operating LLM/AI-assisted developer tooling at scale (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) inside an enterprise is preferred.

- Familiarity with Okta/OIDC and enterprise auth patterns for internal platforms is preferred.

- Experience with engineering productivity metrics tooling (LinearB or similar) and AI-based code review tooling (Qodo or similar) is preferred.

- Experience with vector databases and RAG pipelines (e.g. Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector, or similar) in a production setting is preferred.

- Exposure to model fine-tuning or lightweight training pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA or similar) for domain-specific model adaptation is preferred.
