As a Senior Analyst, Pricing Programs & Analytics, you will sit at the intersection of commercial program execution and applied pricing analytics. You will own the operational mechanics that keep the Flex program running, the feedback loops and documentation that connect field reality to program design, and the deal-level intelligence — performance reporting, price realization analysis, and trend identification — that translates data into decisions. You will work closely with Advanced Analytics, Deal Desk, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems to ensure pricing programs are well-run, well-documented, and continuously improving.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Flex Program Operations & Administration

- Maintain and administer the day-to-day mechanics of the Flex program — including rule documentation, eligibility criteria, CPQ floor configurations, and Deal Desk guidance — ensuring program parameters are accurately reflected in systems and field-facing materials.

- Own the Flex enhancement roadmap tracker: documenting Fast Follow and Future Enhancement items, tracking owner accountability, sequencing dependencies, and flagging items at risk of slipping across quarters.

- Coordinate cross-functional follow-through on approved enhancement items — tracking progress with IT, CPQ, Deal Desk, and Enablement without driving senior stakeholder conversations directly.

- Produce and maintain requirements documentation for CPQ and system changes — translating approved program changes into clear, executable specifications and coordinating Deal Desk validation once changes are built.

- Program Analytics & Commercial Intelligence

- Consume outputs from the Pricing Guidance Engine to produce program-level adoption and compliance reporting — tracking how Flex deals align to guidance corridors, where discounting concentrates, and how program participation correlates with deal outcomes such as win rates, deal velocity, and expansion rates.

- Build and maintain program-specific performance views on top of Advanced Analytics' strategic baselines — including Flex attach rates, deal size distributions, remix frequency, and platform expansion patterns.

- Own price waterfall interpretation at the Flex program level — surfacing how Flex deals flow from list to net pocket price, identifying program-specific margin leakage patterns, and feeding findings back to Advanced Analytics.

- Produce deal behavior analysis that connects Flex and commercial program participation to measurable field outcomes — equipping leadership with a clear picture of what the program is doing to deal quality, not just deal volume.

- Participate in the price realization process — measuring the gap between intended list pricing and what is actually collected after discounts, concessions, and program incentives are applied.

- Analyze transactional data to identify price realization trends and anomalies — by segment, route to market, geography, or deal type — and produce structured findings that distinguish systematic execution gaps from one-off exceptions.

- Surface price realization insights that connect to program behavior — identifying how Flex participation and commercial program structures are influencing the spread between list and realized price.

- Field Feedback & Program Intelligence

- Own the seller and partner feedback collection process — designing and distributing surveys, compiling results, and synthesizing field sentiment into organized summaries that leadership can act on.

- Maintain a running tracker of field feedback across Slack threads, Deal Desk escalations, and stakeholder calls — ensuring patterns are captured and recurring friction points are surfaced with supporting evidence.

- Build and maintain QBR materials for the Pricing Programs team, translating performance data and deal behavior analysis into structured, presentation-ready assets for leadership review.

- Process Documentation & Enablement Content

- Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of internal Flex process documentation — including step-by-step flows for remixes, debook/rebook migrations, and common field scenarios — published via Highspot with version control.

- Maintain the comprehensive internal Flex guide as the single source of truth for AEs, CSMs, Deal Desk, channel sellers, and new hires — keeping it current as program rules evolve.

- Maintain and refresh field-facing program materials — including the seller cheat sheet, program one-pagers, FAQs, and eligibility summaries — as pricing rules, thresholds, and features change.

- Support the development of sales motion-specific enablement assets — including ICP materials, success story compilations, and deal structuring reference guides — working alongside Enablement and Product Marketing.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
Ideal candidates will have:

- 4+ years in pricing programs, revenue operations, sales operations, or a commercial analytics role within a SaaS environment.

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain performance datasets, interpret deal behavior data, and translate outputs into structured, actionable summaries.

- Experience producing and maintaining operational documentation — process flows, program guides, enablement materials — with a track record of keeping content current, version-controlled, and well-organized.

- Familiarity with CPQ systems and commercial program mechanics — including eligibility logic, quoting rules, and discount structures — sufficient to write clear system requirements and validate changes.

- Understanding of SaaS commercial models, including subscription, consumption, and hybrid structures, and how commercial vehicles like Flex operate in a field selling context.

- Proficiency with data tools (Excel, SQL, or BI platforms such as Looker or Tableau) to build program scorecards, deal behavior reports, and performance views on top of existing analytical baselines.

- Comfortable working within an established analytical framework — applying and extending existing models and baselines rather than building the intelligence layer independently.

- Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills; able to work effectively with Sales, Deal Desk, Enablement, Advanced Analytics, IT, and Partner teams.

- High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without items falling through the cracks.

- Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or platform pricing is a plus.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a vital role in designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our cyber threat detection research (core and critical part of our product). This infrastructure will enable data scientists and security researchers to make sense of petabytes of data and uncover the threats that matter. What will you do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that process petabytes of security data (we ingest 5-10 petabytes daily) for research purposes.

- Develop production-grade pipelines, applying software engineering best practices.

- Operate big data infrastructure and cloud data warehouses with a focus on reliability and performance.

- Partner with data scientists and security researchers to deliver impactful data solutions.

- Ensure data quality, observability, and governance across the platform.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 4+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, and distributed systems

- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python (that we use), Java, Scala, or similar.

- Experience with cloud-based technologies such as AWS (our primary), GCP or Azure.

- Experience with deploying big data technologies such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive, IceBerg, Trino.

- Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.

- Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI, Grafana or similar.

- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop innovative solutions to complex problems.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly present and explain complex data and models to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be tasked with joining our Static AI team, which develops state-of-the-art ML models that operate on millions of machines worldwide, evaluate billions of events daily, and make sub-second decisions to stop malware before it runs. You will bring together cross-functional skill sets, including data science, ML engineering, and software engineering, to research, develop, ship, and support ML malware detection engines across Windows, Mac, and Linux machines and cloud environments.

Primary responsibilities include:

- Design and deliver innovative ML-based detection engines that make sub-second decisions to stop malware before it runs.

- Research new approaches to AI and ML, and work with your peers to integrate the most promising advancements into our product.

- Build analytics systems that learn from a wide variety of internal and external data sources to improve existing ML models and create new ones.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- A degree in Computer Science or Mathematics, or equivalent experience.

- Experience collecting, building, and tailoring large datasets for training ML models, specifically with classical ML algorithms, along with a solid grounding in fundamental ML concepts and statistics.

- Active use of AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

- Ability to work collaboratively to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

- 3 or more years of experience designing, training, and evaluating ML models in production systems.

- Independence, with the ability to own a project end-to-end from research to production and to work through difficult problems alone, since our ML problems might be "classical," but the actual setting of these problems is far from easy or convenient.

- Strong communication skills, and the ability to communicate with people outside the team across a wide range of backgrounds and positions (product, support, engineering).

- Willingness and ability to work in a diverse, globally distributed team.

- A fiery determination and a strong team-player mindset; the team's defining trait is an "all hands on deck" attitude.

- Cyber domain experience, working on security products, especially detection systems (preferably static file analysis or detection), is preferred.

- Cloud infrastructure and MLOps experience is preferred.

- Experience with Spark, PySpark, or Databricks is preferred.

- Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals and best practices for managing both stateless and stateful workloads in production or air-gapped deployments.

- Multi-cloud experience with production expertise in at least one major provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

As a DFIR Analyst, you will be tasked with delivering rapid, expert breach response for global enterprises facing active cyber threats as part of SentinelOne's Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) team, which operates 24x7x365 on a follow-the-sun model. Working under the direction of an investigation's Technical Lead and Engagement Manager, you will execute hands-on forensic analysis, threat hunting, and investigative work across live incidents spanning endpoint, network, and cloud environments, and incident types from ransomware and business email compromise to identity compromise, zero-day exploitation, APT activity, and cloud/SaaS breaches. This is a foundational technical role built on rigor, where every conclusion must be evidence-backed, every case well-documented, and every finding able to hold up to scrutiny.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Conduct EDR-driven incident response and vendor-agnostic forensic analysis spanning endpoint, network, cloud, and SaaS environments, including ransomware, business email compromise, identity compromise, and other common incident types.

- Support malware and memory analysis tasks under the guidance of senior team members.

- Acquire and preserve forensic evidence from endpoint, network, and cloud sources, following standard chain-of-custody procedures.

- Support case intake by gathering initial technical details to assess scope, and support incident containment actions and security hardening recommendations.

- Maintain thorough case documentation throughout each investigation.

- Follow standard operating procedures and escalate technical or logistical questions to the assigned Technical Lead or Engagement Manager as needed.

- Contribute to customer-facing status updates, formal investigative reports, and handovers of investigations across regions as needed, distilling complex technical findings for stakeholders.

- Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attacker techniques, and evolving cybersecurity trends, and contribute observed techniques and indicators to the team's shared knowledge base.

- Be responsive to high-pressure triage and analysis during large-scale cybersecurity incidents, maintaining composure.

- Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for weekends and holidays.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- A bachelor's or master's degree in Digital Forensics, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical self-study, plus 3 or more years of hands-on experience in digital forensics, incident response, or threat hunting, ideally in a consulting or services delivery environment.

- Comfort analyzing Windows environments and forensic artifacts, with a foundational understanding of forensic methodologies, evidence handling, acquisition techniques, and chain-of-custody procedures.

- Experience with forensic tools such as X-Ways Forensics, Axiom, and FTK; with EDR/XDR platforms (SentinelOne preferred) and SIEMs; and working knowledge of network protocols and network-based forensic analysis.

- Scripting and automation capabilities.

- Strong verbal and written communication, with comfort documenting and presenting technical findings clearly and precisely.

- Ability to perform technical investigations under pressure in high-stakes, time-sensitive situations, while maintaining composure.

- An evident self-starter with intellectual curiosity and the ability to adapt to change.

- Knowledge of Linux and macOS forensic analysis, exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and memory analysis, and foundational experience conducting malware analysis and understanding the reverse engineering process are preferred.

- Familiarity with endpoint threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence platforms, the MITRE ATT&CK framework, and AI-assisted tools for streamlining triage, analysis, or reporting workflows is preferred.

- Relevant industry certifications, such as GCFE, GCFA, GREM, CFCE, or EnCE, and interest in contributing to industry publications, research, or speaking engagements are preferred.

Primary responsibilities include:

- Design a dual-track operational framework tailored to two distinct motion archetypes: VARs, focused on project-based Professional Services, rapid time-to-delivery, and transaction speed; and MSSPs, focused on recurring operational health, API and SOC integration, multi-tenant enablement, and sustained consumption.

- Operationalize structured growth programs through adoption and product upsell and services for our technical customer-facing and partner-facing teams.

- Turn recurring technical issues into proactive enablement and deflection programs that reduce escalations and raise partner self-sufficiency.

- Partner with Support Leadership to analyze ticket telemetry and recurring technical friction points across the journey to better understand our partners, our customers, and adoption friction points.

- Create proactive structures that are scalable throughout the technical journey and connect the right resources at the right time.

- Build unified workflows and handoffs between our technical customer-facing and partner-facing teams.

- Ensure that SentinelOne is portrayed in a positive, authentic way as an ethical provider of reliable, effective, and scalable security solutions for all of our partners.

- Deep understanding of the channel ecosystem (VARs, MSPs, MSSPs, Global System Integrators) and how technical services drive channel revenue.

- Demonstrated ability to translate operational insights into actionable retention and growth campaigns that deliver measurable NRR impact.

- Hands-on experience structuring operational programs for both transactional VARs and recurring-revenue MSSPs/MSPs.

- Conceptual understanding of how managed security service providers integrate vendor technology into their SOC stack (SIEM/SOAR/EDR integrations, multi-tenancy, service desk handoffs).

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will be tasked with building, scaling, and optimizing SentinelOne's core data and caching infrastructure running at massive scale across Kubernetes clusters and multi-cloud environments. You will unlock complete cloud portability for applications and services while ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and cost-effective operations. Your work will directly empower our autonomous cybersecurity platform to process petabytes of daily data with 99.99% uptime.

What will you do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Lead the design, operation, and end-to-end platform experience of mission-critical distributed data services, including Kafka or Redis, across Kubernetes clusters and multi-cloud environments.

- Unlock complete cloud portability for SentinelOne apps and services by building a highly automated, self-service infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and air-gapped on-prem environments.

- Manage and scale data infrastructure supporting petabytes/day ingestion to ensure low-latency, high-throughput, and cost-effective operations.

- Consolidate and optimize multi-tenant Kafka clusters to reduce cost, improve resilience, and streamline operations.

- Drive lifecycle automation for distributed data services using GitOps principles and tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and Terraform to minimize operational toil and pager burden.

- Define and implement standards for observability, high availability (HA), backup, and disaster recovery (DR) of workloads in Kubernetes.

- Partner with FinOps and engineering stakeholders to continuously optimize performance, cost, and operational overhead across data platform components.

What skills and knowledge should you bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 5+ of experience in infrastructure, platform, or DevOps engineering with a proven track record of operating distributed systems at scale.

- Hands-on experience with self-hosted Kafka and/or Redis running in Kubernetes, including performance tuning, scaling, and operator-based lifecycle management.

- Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals and best practices for managing both stateless and stateful workloads in production or air-gapped deployments.

- Multi-cloud experience with production expertise in at least one major provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps practices using tools like Terraform, ArgoCD, and CI/CD workflow automation (GitHub Actions).

- Strong scripting or development skills in at least one mainstream language like Python, Go, or Ruby.

- Share research findings with other detection teams and collaborate across internal/external groups to strengthen detection capability.

- Own detection coverage end to end: write and maintain detection assets, be accountable for FP/FN quality, detection efficacy and performance.

- Design and maintain the CI/testing infrastructure used to build, test, and ship detection content safely.

- Respond quickly to emerging threats and customer detection escalations for malware requests.

- Support detection coverage validation against BAS (Breach and Attack Simulation) frameworks.

- Mentor other engineers on Linux/macOS malware analysis and detection engineering practices.

- Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK TTPs.

- A strong inclination toward automating routine analysis and detection workflows.

- Excellent and deep understanding of Linux (both user-mode and kernel-mode):

Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Offensive Security Researcher you will join a global team working across Windows, Linux and macOS, spanning Endpoint, Cloud and Identity - and push the boundaries of cybersecurity every day! You will research evasions against our own sensors, track the offensive tooling landscape and drive innovative research that anticipates the next generation of attacker tradecraft. By being part of our team, your work will impact protection of customer environments worldwide, incl. at 4 of Fortune10 and hundreds of Global2000, and you will have a chance to work on a industry-leading security product (recognized 6x in-a-row as Gartner Leaders, scoring highly in Mitre Att&ck, in Frost Radar, SE Labs and by others).

What will you do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Proactively look for the newest and most sophisticated attack techniques, deeply research and understand their internals, and emulate these attacks to assess and improve our detection engines.

- Build tools to support detection assessments, create proofs-of-concept for the newest techniques and contribute to the design of innovative detection strategies.

- Work closely with our Threat-Intelligence team and engineering detection teams to provide guidance and highlight gaps in our detection and visibility capabilities.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 4+ years of experience in Red Teaming / Security Research / Offensive Research with a deep understanding of Windows internals.

- Hands-on experience with coding in Python and C/C++.

- Deep understanding of the malware world (how malware operates, infamous families, evasion and exploitation techniques).

- Experience in malware analysis (statically and dynamically) and reverse engineering (x86/x64)

- Understanding of existing EDRs internals.

- Experience writing detection signatures.

- Experience leveraging agentic AI workflows for malware analysis and detection engineering tasks (reverse engineering, code auditing, signature writing).

- Proven track record of conference speaking at security conferences or publications is an advantage

Why SentinelOne?

- Raise the bar on product quality by identifying gaps in testability, observability, reliability, and release readiness.

- Help extend quality coverage into Cloud AI Security as our CNAPP capabilities expand to secure customers' AI workloads and infrastructure.

- Drive better quality processes, dashboards, reporting, and CI signals for faster and safer releases.

- Mentor other engineers on automation best practices, debugging, and quality engineering principles.

Ideal candidates will have:

- 5+ years of experience in test automation / automation development.

- Strong product thinking with the ability to translate product behavior and customer workflows into effective test strategy.

- Strong hands-on experience building API and service-level test automation for complex, distributed systems and microservices.

- Strong proficiency in Python and TypeScript; experience with Go is a plus.

- Hands-on experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium and Playwright where UI coverage is needed.

- Experience testing services that run on at least one public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and on Kubernetes (Docker).

- Experience debugging issues deeply and working closely with developers to drive fixes.

- Strong experience with Jenkins-based CI pipelines and test execution workflows.

- Experience with Allure or similar test reporting / insights platforms.

- Solid understanding of automation architecture, test design, and maintainable framework development.

- Integrate AI-powered tools and workflows into the validation lifecycle to automate test triaging, PR analysis, and reduce manual QA tasks.

- Leverage Generative AI and LLMs to optimize test case generation, improve test coverage, and boost overall team productivity.

- Utilize Docker for containerization to create consistent testing environments.

- Manage and execute tests in cloud environments, including AWS and GCP.

- Continuously enhance test strategies to improve coverage, efficiency, and effectiveness.

- Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression and security testing.

- Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution.

- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes and methodologies.

- Stay up-to-date with industry best practices and emerging technologies in validation and quality assurance.

- Participate in code reviews and design discussions to ensure testability and quality from the early stages of development.

- 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance or validation engineering, with a strong focus on SaaS products.

- Proven experience in leading validation efforts and defining comprehensive test strategies.

- Experience in developing and maintaining automated test frameworks in Python and/or TypeScript, Playwright (or similar, such as Java).

- Hands-on experience integrating AI tools, LLMs, or AI-driven testing methodologies into daily QA workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

- Familiarity with prompt engineering and utilizing AI assistants to streamline testing processes and automate repetitive tasks.

- Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.

- Proven experience with AWS,or GCP, and with Docker, Kubernetes, plus event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar.

- Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, or GitLab.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, with globally distributed teams.

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

Salary starting from 4100 EUR/month. Annual bonus based on company performance, paid in two installments. The final base salary may be adjusted based on the individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Detection Platform group, you will be tasked with participating in the design and execution of backend systems that process billions of events and several petabytes of data daily and serve tens of thousands of security specialists at enterprise and government customers worldwide.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Operational Excellence: Own the full lifecycle of large-scale production services - design, develop (mostly in Go and/or Java), test, deploy, and operate them while holding a high bar for observability, performance, and reliability - from proactive monitoring and diagnostics through incident response.

- Technical Evolution: Keep the existing codebase healthy through ongoing refactoring and disciplined delivery of fixes and features, while continuously evaluating and adopting new technologies that address the scale and complexity of our data challenges.

- System Design at Scale: Participate in the design and implementation of highly available, low-latency, cloud-native services built to process high volume of events, keeping them reliable and performant for the world’s largest enterprises and governments.

- AI-Native Engineering: Leverage AI across the development process and raise the bar for how we design, review, and ship products.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Drive complex initiatives that span multiple teams to completion, align engineering, product, and design on technical direction, and act as a key stakeholder in cross-organizational architecture reviews.

- Requirements into Architecture: Turn vaguely specified, complex requirements into robust, scalable, operable end-to-end designs that fit the overall data architecture, and define the coding patterns and standards other teams build on.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Staff, Information Security Risk, you will be tasked with owning SentinelOne's Security Risk Program outright, running the day-to-day cadence that identifies, scores, prioritizes, and drives down technical risk across the company. You will build the governance, automation, and review that turn a functioning risk register into a genuinely predictive risk management capability, and you will be trusted to run the program without supervision and to stand in for GRC leadership when the situation calls for it. Success in this role depends on credibility: knowing the technology, scoring risk fairly, and never bringing a problem to review without having already done the work.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Serve as the accountable owner for the Security Risk program, covering cadence, scoring methodology, reporting, escalation, and the standard operating procedure that governs it, and keep the program audit-ready with decisions documented, approvals logged, procedure current, and evidence retrievable.

- Contribute to the broader GRC functional strategy and multi-year roadmap, and advise leadership on how risk register data should inform security investment and resourcing decisions.

- Own the escalation path end-to-end, from critical-risk notification through executive resolution of cross-team prioritization conflicts, and provide day-to-day technical leadership and oversight for risk analysts at all levels.

- Own the intake pipeline for risks submitted from every source, including internal observation, audit findings, penetration tests, red team exercises, vulnerability scans, threat modeling, tabletop exercises, incidents, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, SOX, FedRAMP, IRAP, C5, UK Cyber, and NIST CSF.

- Validate and baseline likelihood and impact scoring using an ISO 27005-aligned methodology, and defend those ratings to engineering and security stakeholders who will not always agree with them.

- Enforce triage service levels, including same-day escalation for critical risks, expedited handling for the next tier, and standard bi-weekly handling for everything else, and hold the line on data quality and field completeness across the register.

- Prepare and facilitate the recurring risk review with security leadership, covering new and unreviewed risks, service-level breaches, in-flight risk health, and risks awaiting final acceptance, and drive mitigation plans to approval, ensuring every critical risk has an approved plan or full remediation within the program's commitment window.

- Adjudicate risk treatment decisions and make sure residual risk is documented, evidenced, and re-scored rather than quietly closed out.

- Build and present the Program Review to security and engineering leadership, covering program status, risk counts and quarter-over-quarter trends, critical category analysis, prior-quarter commitments delivered versus missed, and the top five to six efforts selected for the coming quarter, and run the baselining of the entire register against new results, backlog and active project review, and the current threat landscape.

- Build repeatable, queryable automation and AI-assisted workflows that generate review prep and quarterly metrics on demand, design and land program enhancements on the roadmap such as anonymous risk submission, a service-desk intake portal, executive-owner accountability tracking, application and system scope tracking, and re-modeling risk treatment status into the workflow itself, and extend the register into emerging domains, including AI risk, while integrating internal and external threat intelligence into the risk identification process.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- At least 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years of experience; or equivalent practical experience.

- Expert-level knowledge across multiple cybersecurity domains, for example application security, cloud security, identity and access management, network security, data protection, endpoint security, and third-party risk, with genuine depth in more than one niche rather than surface familiarity across all of them.

- Deep, hands-on experience with cybersecurity risk management, including risk identification, qualitative and quantitative scoring, treatment decisions, residual risk, and remediation tracking, grounded in a recognized methodology such as ISO 27005, ISO 27001, NIST RMF, NIST CSF, or FAIR.

- Demonstrated experience building or substantially maturing a GRC function or program, not just operating one that someone else designed, and a track record of leading projects that span multiple teams or sub-functions, executed with minimal supervision and delivered to a high standard.

- Experience mentoring and providing technical oversight to analysts, including senior analysts.

- Proven ability to communicate risk to executive audiences, translating technical findings into business impact, building the narrative, and defending the recommendation in the room.

- Working familiarity with at least one major compliance framework relevant to enterprise software, such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, IRAP, C5, or similar, and practical fluency with Jira, including JQL, custom field schemas, workflow design, and permission and issue-security models.

- Experience running a risk register at scale, hundreds of concurrent risks across a large, distributed engineering organization, is preferred, as is experience standing in for or acting as a deputy to a GRC leader, including during incidents and other high-pressure situations.

- Automation and data skills such as SQL, Python, Google Apps Script, Jira automation, or AI-assisted workflow tooling used to eliminate recurring manual reporting are preferred, as is a background in a cybersecurity product company or another environment where the security team's own posture is subject to unusual external scrutiny.

- Experience assessing AI and machine learning risk, or integrating threat intelligence into a formal risk management process, is preferred, as are relevant certifications such as CISSP, CRISC, CISA, CISM, or an ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer credential.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. - Serve as SentinelOne's executive escalation leader during strategically significant customer situations.

- Customer- and outcome-oriented mindset with a passion for solving complex enterprise customer challenges.

- 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Strategic Accounts, Consulting, or comparable executive customer-facing roles.

- Proven experience leading executive customer engagements involving complex technical, operational, or commercial challenges.

- Demonstrated experience leading customers through major technical incidents, executive escalations, platform outages, or complex enterprise deployments.

- Strong executive presence with the ability to establish credibility quickly with Fortune 500 technology and business leaders.

- Deep technical expertise in enterprise cybersecurity platforms, endpoint protection, cloud security, identity, SIEM, MDR, networking, or adjacent security technologies, with the ability to quickly understand complex customer environments and technical architectures.

- Ability to engage as a trusted technical advisor with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Security Architects, SOC leaders, Engineering leaders, and executive business stakeholders while translating technical complexity into executive decision-making.

- Strong commercial acumen, including enterprise renewals, contract negotiations, executive commercial strategy, and long-term customer planning.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional execution without direct authority.

- Ability to rapidly synthesize information across Product, Engineering, Support, telemetry, and customer environments to develop practical recovery strategies.

- Strong systems thinking with the ability to manage multiple technical workstreams simultaneously while maintaining executive-level customer confidence.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple high-profile customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Highly Desirable

- Experience in a Critical Accounts Program (CAP), executive customer advocacy, enterprise customer recovery, or similar strategic customer engagement program.

- Experience as a Principal Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Consulting Architect, Escalation Manager, Customer Reliability Engineer, or similar highly technical customer-facing leadership role.

- Previous Customer Success leadership, Strategic Account Management, or Professional Services leadership experience.

- Experience partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Technical Support organizations.

- Hands-on experience managing customer recovery during major incidents, platform outages, or enterprise-scale technical escalations.

- Executive relationship management experience with Fortune 500 customers.

- Cybersecurity industry experience.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

- Lead complex implementation and onboarding projects for S1 products and services.

- Work closely with internal stakeholders to advocate customer needs cross-departmentally, resolve technical and business issues, define feature requests, identify growth opportunities, and collect customer feedback.

- During incidents and outages, serve as the customer's point of contact and voice of SentinelOne, while internally organizing teams and coordinating communication channels.

- Present technical working and learning sessions to improve the overall customer experience.

- Manage and mentor team members, and coordinate across the organization to advocate for the team and its activities.

- Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, content and topics surrounding S1, cybersecurity, and endpoint management.

- 3 to 5 years of experience directly engaging with enterprise customers.

- US-based status, required to support and operate within SentinelOne's FedRAMP infrastructure.

- Deep understanding of security technologies, architecture, and operations, with a track record of advising customers on industry best practices, and in-depth knowledge of threat handling, incident response, and SOC operations.

- Partner with Engineering and R&D on complex, product-level escalations.

- Working knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

- Hands-on experience with memory and crash dump analysis and log analysis for root-cause troubleshooting.

- Ability to work effectively in a queue-driven, SLA-bound support environment across shifts as required.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers.

- Ability to manage competing priorities across queue monitoring, live chat, and case work in a fast-paced environment.

As a Threat Response Advisor, you will be tasked with serving as a trusted advisor for SentinelOne's Managed Detection & Response (MDR) customers — guiding them from onboarding through ongoing service delivery, and advising on endpoint protection, threat detection, incident response, and recovery.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Own the MDR service delivered to your assigned customers, partnering with their Customer Success Manager, sales rep, and Technical Account Manager on all issues and initiatives.

- Lead initial customer engagement: introduce the MDR service scope and SOPs, advise on Singularity Platform configuration (endpoint policies, third-party integrations), define escalation and response policies, and document environment details for the global MDR team.

- Run ongoing customer engagement: review MDR operational metrics and trends, brief customers on emerging threats and recommended actions, resolve outstanding questions, and recommend corrective actions to reduce risk.

- Support Proof of Concept (POC) engagements for prospective MDR customers, and represent MDR services at company events and conferences.

- Stay embedded with MDR operations and the threat landscape through shadow days and rotations with analysts, investigators, and engineers, and channel customer/prospect feedback into continuous service improvement.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Experience as a security operations practitioner in SOC operations, security monitoring, incident investigation/response, malware analysis, threat hunting, or threat intelligence.

- A strong background in security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence, with a genuine passion for protecting customers from cyber attacks.

- Solid understanding of the current threat landscape, including common attacker TTPs and prominent threat actor groups.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- Proven experience managing complex customer escalations and collaborating across internal teams to drive resolution.

Why SentinelOne?

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher, you will be tasked with leading deep-dive investigations into both emerging and known threats, while maintaining a vigilant watch over malware developments to ensure defenses remain a step ahead of evolving attack methods. - Map threat actor footprints internally by pivoting through EDR telemetry.

- Analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) within the environment, identifying shifts in execution, persistence, and lateral movement.

- Trace adversary infrastructure externally by pivoting through domain registrations, SSL certificates, and passive DNS.

- Knowledge of the cyber threat landscape, including threat actors and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

As a Software Engineering Manager - Test Platform, you will lead SentinelOne's SaaS Test Platform Service team, setting operational objectives, work plans, and quality strategy for quality of SentinelOne SaaS services on the Singularity platform. You will manage and grow a team of automation and software engineers, translating company and organizational strategy into test frameworks, tools and services that improve developer experience and product quality, while building a culture of excellence at SentinelOne. You will manage clear team goals while championing continuous learning, technical depth, and best practices in test standards and automation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and other managers and directors to ensure high quality standards for testing and coverage of SentinelOne products and services.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Establish operational objectives, work plans, and quality strategy for ensuring quality in code through all phases of the software development lifecycle, and implement policies that affect the development team's operations.

- Manage and grow a team of test automation and software engineers, delegating assignments, setting performance expectations, and holding regular performance and career development discussions.

- Champion the team's adoption of automated test frameworks, Docker-based test environments, and cloud validation across AWS and GCP, while integrating AI-powered tools into the validation lifecycle.

- Own the team's charter as an internal enablement function: build and evolve the standards, tools, and frameworks that other engineering teams consume for testing across the full pyramid unit, component, integration, end-to-end, and persona-based.

- Partner with directors, managers, and cross-functional stakeholders in development, validation, and other engineering teams to align on requirements, schedules, and work plans, and to advocate for the team's priorities.

- Drive adoption of the platform across the organization through documentation, onboarding, office hours, quick turn-arounds on feedback, and internal evangelism making it the obvious, easiest path for teams to test their features well.

- Hold the team accountable for project and quality results, resolving prioritization conflicts using consistent criteria around effort and impact, and making trade-off calls when information is incomplete.

- Define and track platform health and adoption metrics coverage, test flakiness, pipeline reliability, and time-to-onboard and report progress and impact to engineering leadership.

- Drive continuous improvement of testing processes, coverage, and methodologies across the team, sharing insights and best practices with peer managers and the wider organization.

- Coach and mentor engineers on the team, invest time in their growth, AI development transformations, and identify and address competency gaps.

- Foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and psychological safety within the team, ensuring all team members have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Years of experience as an individual contributor in software quality assurance, validation engineering, or test automation, ideally including some experience managing or leading a team.

- Experience managing or leading a team of 5 or more engineers, or strong readiness to step into people management, including supporting hiring and performance discussions.

- Solid domain expertise in test frameworks, automation and quality engineering, with the ability to lead and engage in technical and architecture level conversations with senior individual contributors at the Staff level and above.

- Strong understanding of test frameworks and tooling such as Python (Pytest) and TypeScript (Playwright), containerization with Docker, and cloud environments such as AWS and GCP.

- Experience designing or scaling an internal developer platform / "paved road" testing model that other engineering teams adopt by choice rather than mandate.

- Solid grasp of the full test pyramid unit, component, integration, E2E, and persona-based testing and judgment about which layer best fits a given testing problem.

- Experience setting quality engineering strategy, budgets, and work plans for an organization, and implementing policies that affect team and cross-team operations.

- Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate company and organizational strategy into clear, meaningful goals for the team.

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with experience working effectively with peer managers, directors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

- A track record of coaching and developing engineers, with a strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and building high-performing teams.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

- Performance-based bonus

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off, on top of the standard 5 weeks PTO

- Paid company wellness days and fully paid short-term sick/nursing leave

- Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

- Private medical care benefit

- Life and disability insurance

- Pension Insurance contribution

- Global business travel medical insurance

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

- Wellbeing allowance

- Wellness Coach app

- Own the outbound stack, integrating sales engagement, conversation intelligence, enrichment, and CRM so rep-facing data stays accurate and actionable, for example Outreach/Salesloft, Gong/Chorus, Salesforce, and ZoomInfo/Clearbit.

- Make quality measurable by building evals for outreach personalization quality, call-summary accuracy, and signal precision against human baselines.

- Build the guardrails, implementing human-in-the-loop review for anything rep- or customer-facing, plus logging and rollback paths.

- Coach and document, bringing SDRs, AEs, and revenue operations up the AI curve and building playbooks and reusable templates.

As a Technical Success Executive, you will be tasked with leading executive-level recovery efforts for SentinelOne's most strategically significant enterprise customers, combining deep cybersecurity technical expertise with commercial acumen to restore trust and drive successful outcomes. You will serve as the primary executive partner for both the customer and internal teams, coordinating Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success functions around a unified recovery strategy. This role demands rapid diagnosis of complex technical, operational, and commercial challenges while building lasting confidence with C-level stakeholders.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Become the primary executive partner for strategically significant customer engagements, building trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, executive sponsors, architects, and operational leaders.

- Assume executive ownership of customer situations identified through the Early Warning System, Critical Accounts Program, Crisis Management, executive escalations, or executive leadership.

- Temporarily lead the customer strategy over the existing account team until the engagement reaches a successful resolution, ideally culminating in a successful renewal and transition back to the standard operating model.

- Develop and own Executive Recovery & Success Plans, defining technical milestones, executive engagement plans, commercial strategy, value realization objectives, and exit criteria.

- Lead technical recovery efforts for complex customer situations, including major incidents, product outages, deployment challenges, architecture reviews, competitive technical evaluations, and security operations concerns.

- Rapidly assess complex, multi-threaded technical issues, establish root cause hypotheses, and coordinate Product, Engineering, Support, Technical Account Management, and Professional Services around a unified technical recovery strategy.

- Drive technical value realization by ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their SentinelOne investment.

- Partner directly with Product Management, Engineering, Technical Support, and Architecture teams to remove technical blockers, prioritize customer-critical issues, influence solution direction, and accelerate recovery for strategic customer situations.

- Coordinate cross-functional execution across Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Support, Professional Services, Sales, Renewals, Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership.

- Build and lead executive relationships with customer stakeholders, creating alignment, restoring confidence, and ensuring technical and commercial objectives remain synchronized throughout the engagement.

- Provide executive-level technical guidance to customer stakeholders, translating complex engineering issues into clear business impact, recovery plans, and value realization strategies.

- Participate directly in renewal negotiations, contract strategy, commercial structuring, pricing strategy, and multi-year planning to achieve the right long-term outcome for both the customer and SentinelOne.

- Identify recurring technical, operational, and commercial trends and provide structured feedback to Product, Engineering, Customer Experience, and GTM leadership.

- Serve as SentinelOne's executive escalation leader during strategically significant customer situations.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Customer- and outcome-oriented mindset with a passion for solving complex enterprise customer challenges.

- 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Strategic Accounts, Consulting, or comparable executive customer-facing roles.

- Proven experience leading executive customer engagements involving complex technical, operational, or commercial challenges.

- Demonstrated experience leading customers through major technical incidents, executive escalations, platform outages, or complex enterprise deployments.

- Strong executive presence with the ability to establish credibility quickly with Fortune 500 technology and business leaders.

- Deep technical expertise in enterprise cybersecurity platforms, endpoint protection, cloud security, identity, SIEM, MDR, networking, or adjacent security technologies, with the ability to quickly understand complex customer environments and technical architectures.

- Ability to engage as a trusted technical advisor with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Security Architects, SOC leaders, Engineering leaders, and executive business stakeholders while translating technical complexity into executive decision-making.

- Strong commercial acumen, including enterprise renewals, contract negotiations, executive commercial strategy, and long-term customer planning.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional execution without direct authority.

- Ability to rapidly synthesize information across Product, Engineering, Support, telemetry, and customer environments to develop practical recovery strategies.

- Strong systems thinking with the ability to manage multiple technical workstreams simultaneously while maintaining executive-level customer confidence.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple high-profile customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience in a Critical Accounts Program (CAP), executive customer advocacy, enterprise customer recovery, or similar strategic customer engagement program.

- Experience as a Principal Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Consulting Architect, Escalation Manager, Customer Reliability Engineer, or similar highly technical customer-facing leadership role.

- Previous Customer Success leadership, Strategic Account Management, or Professional Services leadership experience.

- Experience partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Technical Support organizations.

- Hands-on experience managing customer recovery during major incidents, platform outages, or enterprise-scale technical escalations.

- Executive relationship management experience with Fortune 500 customers.

- Cybersecurity industry experience.

postings.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will help secure tens of millions of devices across Windows, Linux, and macOS while processing billions of security events every day as part of SentinelOne’s Endpoint Protection product line.

We are looking for an excellent software engineer with a reliability-first mindset who thrives on solving complex distributed systems challenges in production and turning those learnings into durable platform improvements and long-term engineering ownership.

You’ll help drive customer-critical incident response across the Agent Platform, rapidly build context across multiple platform services, and partner with engineering teams to continuously improve the platform’s reliability, operability, and scalability as a whole.

You will build and evolve the high-throughput, highly available services responsible for policy, configuration, and command distribution to millions of agents worldwide, while contributing to the agent platform protocols that enable other SentinelOne teams to deliver new security capabilities safely and at scale.

This role offers broad technical ownership, the opportunity to work across service boundaries, and the ability to influence the design and reliability of critical platform capabilities used throughout the Agent Platform at SentinelOne. You’ll solve some of the company’s most complex production challenges while helping shape the future of our platform.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Drive rapid response to customer-critical incidents by diagnosing, triaging, and resolving complex production issues that span multiple services across the Agent Platform.

- Lead systematic root-cause analysis and translate incident learnings into durable reliability, scalability, observability, and operability improvements.

- Quickly build a systems-level understanding of unfamiliar services and codebases, collaborating closely with engineering teams to resolve complex cross-service issues.

- Design, develop, test, document, deploy, and operate large-scale, high-volume, low-latency distributed systems processing millions of events per second.

- Understand, maintain, and continuously improve existing services through refactoring, feature development, and architectural enhancements.

- Maintain application stability and data integrity by monitoring key metrics, improving operational visibility, and continuously strengthening the codebase.

- Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, and operable technical solutions.

- Partner closely with engineering teams across SentinelOne to solve cross-functional problems, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that scale.

- Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies that improve the platform’s scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

Your Toolkit

- Our backend services are primarily developed in with Go and Python also playing important roles.

- We use gRPC, REST, GraphQL, and Kafka for service communication.

- Our data layer includes Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ClickHouse, and our own columnar time-series database.

- Our services run across multiple AWS and GCP regions on Kubernetes, using Docker, GitHub, and ArgoCD.

- We provide engineers with modern AI-powered tools to improve both engineering productivity and software quality.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 8+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep expertise in at least one of Go or Python.

- A reliability-first mindset with a proven ability to solve complex production incidents, perform systematic root-cause analysis, and implement durable engineering solutions that prevent recurrence.

- Demonstrated ability to quickly understand unfamiliar distributed systems, navigate large codebases, and troubleshoot complex failures across service boundaries.

- Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a deep understanding of failure modes, performance trade-offs, resilience patterns, and operational excellence.

- Experience with AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms, as well as Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes.

- Experience with messaging systems and data platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, ClickHouse, or similar technologies.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, Product, Technical Account Managers, and other stakeholders, influence technical direction, and mentor fellow engineers.

- A high degree of ownership, autonomy, curiosity, and the ability to drive ambiguous technical problems to successful outcomes.

- Experience in an enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity software company is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

- Flexible time off

- Paid company holidays and paid sick time

- Gender-neutral parental leave

- Grandparent leave

- Medical, dental, and vision coverage

- 401(k) retirement plan with company match

- Life and disability insurance

- Health and dependent care FSA

- Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will be tasked with building, scaling, and modernizing our enterprise data platform across modern data engineering, analytics enablement, governance, and AI-ready data foundations. In this role, you will own and improve the trusted data foundation supporting executive reporting, analytics, revenue operations, product insights, customer reporting, finance, GTM, and operational workflows across the company. What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production-grade data pipelines across source systems, cloud data platforms, and business-facing data products, where you'll deal with datasets at petabytes scale.

- Support and improve critical data workflows using BigQuery, GCP, Kestra, Nexla, DataHub, Looker, Tableau, and Workato across Salesforce, billing, ARR, customer data, and finance domains.

- Improve data quality, observability, freshness monitoring, schema validation, reconciliation, alerting, and operational reliability for critical datasets.

- Participate in production support for business-critical data workflows, including incident response, root-cause analysis, and runbook development.

- Strengthen data governance and discoverability through metadata management, lineage, ownership, certification, metric definitions etc.

- Partner with Analytics, BI, Product, Finance, GTM, IT, Security, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver trusted datasets, AI-ready data foundations, and scalable data solutions.

- Leverage AI tools responsibly to increase engineering productivity, including SQL support, Python development, debugging, testing, and operational analysis.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- Advanced SQL and Python proficiency for building, optimizing, troubleshooting, automating, and testing data pipelines across large datasets.

- Proven experience building and supporting batch or near-real-time ingestion pipelines using tools such as Nexla, Workato, Fivetran, APIs, or custom pipelines.

- Must-have: hands-on experience with cloud-based data stack - such as GCP and BigQuery (preferred) or comparable alternative in AWS ecosystem (and its services like Redshift, Athena etc.); including production dataset management, performance tuning, IAM, service accounts, and dev/prod environment separation.

- Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Kestra, Airflow, dbt Cloud, or similar, including scheduling, dependencies, retries, and failure handling.

- Deep understanding of dimensional modeling (facts/dimensions, SCDs) and data quality/reliability practices (reconciliation, schema validation, freshness monitoring, runbooks).

- Familiarity with metadata management, lineage, data catalogs, semantic layers, and engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD, testing, code reviews).

As a Technical Support Escalation Manager to serve as the primary technical interface between Technical Support and SentinelOne Product and Engineering teams for an assigned product area.This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who combines subject-matter expertise, advanced troubleshooting, product knowledge, technical judgment, and strong cross-functional leadership.You will own the quality and prioritization of Engineering escalations coming from Support, challenge issues before they become development work, help Support resolve problems without unnecessary escalation, and ensure genuinely product-related issues reach Engineering with the evidence and urgency required for action.You will also analyze recurring issues and use those insights to improve Support readiness, product quality, documentation, diagnostics, and overall product supportability.The goal is not simply to manage escalations. It is to reduce the need for them.

Primary responsibilities include:

- Serve as the senior Support subject-matter expert for assigned SentinelOne products or technologies.

- Act as the primary technical interface between Technical Support and Product/Engineering for customer-driven escalations.

- Review and validate Support escalations before Engineering engagement.

- Validate technical evidence, customer impact, severity, reproduction steps, logs, diagnostics, and troubleshooting already completed.

- Determine whether issues represent product defects, environmental conditions, configuration issues, known behavior, or Support-solvable problems.

- Deflect unnecessary Engineering escalations by providing solutions, known fixes, technical guidance, documentation, and coaching to Support.

- Prioritize Engineering escalations based on severity, customer impact, breadth of exposure, and business risk.

- Maintain visibility into critical and high-impact defects affecting customers.

- Drive technical escalation execution across Support, Product, and Engineering.

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to improve product supportability.

- Perform trend analysis to identify recurring defects and the highest-impact customer issues.

- Develop and maintain technical knowledge including KBs, troubleshooting guides, training, videos, diagnostics, and internal enablement.

- Coach Frontline and Backline engineers to increase technical capability and reduce repeat escalations.

- Participate in customer-facing escalation calls when advanced technical leadership is required.

- Translate complex Engineering findings into clear guidance for Support teams and customer-facing stakeholders.

- Where appropriate, inspect code, diagnostics, dumps, or other low-level technical artifacts to accelerate root-cause investigation.

- Provide structured product-quality and supportability insights to Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience leadership.

- 7+ years of experience in Technical Support, Escalation Engineering, Software Engineering, Customer Engineering, Security Engineering, or a comparable technical role.

- Deep subject-matter expertise in one or more enterprise security technologies.

- Exceptional troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.

- Demonstrated experience working directly with Product and Engineering organizations.

- Ability to independently assess whether a technical issue represents a product defect.

- Strong understanding of operating systems, enterprise security, cloud technologies, networking, and large-scale software environments.

- Strong technical judgment and ability to balance customer urgency with engineering prioritization.

- Ability to lead cross-functional technical execution without direct authority.

- Excellent technical communication skills.

- Strong coaching and technical enablement capabilities.

- Ability to identify systemic patterns across large numbers of customer issues.

- WinDbg and memory dump analysis

- Process Monitor

- Windows Performance Analyzer

- C++, Rust, Python, or similar languages

As a Staff Forward Deploy Engineer at SentinelOne, you will sit at the intersection of our customers and our product. Your time splits between customer engineering teams and our own codebases– shipping the integrations, fixes, and platform improvements customer deployments require. Your work will touch many products and services across the company including our data pipeline and the Singularity Data Lake and EventDB (our highly scalable columnar database that ingests Petabytes of data per day).

You'll work closely with customers to understand their environments, translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions, and build integrations, customizations, and upstream product contributions that unlock real business value. We're seeking a seasoned colleague, able to own customer engagements end-to-end, inspire others as a Staff Forward Deploy Engineer, and lead technically across unfamiliar codebases and messy problem spaces. You will interact with engineers in and across the org, tech leads, architects, product management, sales, and customer executive stakeholders.

What Will You Do?

- Software Development (fullstack; primarily React/Java)
Dive deep into coding, turning customer requirements and product gaps into shipped solutions. Write robust tests, tackle bugs with finesse, and ensure top-notch security in your code. Expect to move between codebases regularly, including on escalated issues that span multiple products.

- Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering
Partner with customers and our field teams to understand customer environments, goals, and constraints. Turn loose, ambiguous (possibly contradictory!) asks into a clear technical strategy. Carry field learnings back into product and engineering planning while advocating for what customers need. Occasionally support pre-sales scoping where early engineering input shapes a good outcome.

- Customer Integrations, Deployments, and Enablement
Own the design and delivery of integrations that connect SentinelOne products into customer environments. Often this is work you will do alongside the customer's engineers, shaping both the solution and the knowledge transfer that goes with it. Produce the runbooks, integration docs, and executive-level technical communication that let customers operate independently.

- Upstream Contributions to the Core Product
When something needs fixing or improving in the core platform to make a customer whole, you go do it. Partner with platform teams to get contributions reviewed and supported long-term, and know when to invest in the long-term fix versus the near-term unblock. Along the way, build the tooling that codifies repeatable patterns and scales the whole Forward Deploy function.

- Technical Leadership and Mentorship
Raise the bar for the Forward Deploy Engineering team. Mentor Senior Forward Deploy Engineers, set standards for how engagements are scoped and delivered, and shape how the team operates as it grows.

- Build and Review Technical Specifications
Architect end-to-end solutions for complex problems with loose definition, sometimes spanning multiple codebases and owning teams. Document trade-offs and critical implementation details; review and provide meaningful feedback on other specs, understanding broader patterns and downstream/upstream dependencies.

- Code Review
Champion code quality, security, and efficiency. Your keen eye for detail will guide you in reviewing and elevating our codebase– including the codebases you're visiting.

- Support and Team Collaboration
Respond to ad-hoc customer and internal escalations promptly (no regular on-call rotation). Assist your colleagues, share constructive feedback, and contribute to weekly syncs and daily Slack standups.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

We do not require a perfect match with everything below; however, the more this describes you, the better of a fit you will be for this role.

- Experience

- Solid computer science background with 6+ years engineering experience including both backend and frontend.

- Proven expertise designing and operating distributed systems or data-intensive services.

- Track record of leading substantial pieces of work end-to-end, under ambiguity, with multiple stakeholders.

- Experience working directly with customers or senior stakeholders to shape technical solutions.

- Technical Mastery

- Deep proficiency in at least one production language (Java strongly preferred; 5+ years) and working comfort in at least one additional language.

- You value elegant code that is concise and readable.

- You'll pick up new tools and codebases as the work demands, and will likely end up working with modern Java, React, TypeScript, Kafka, Redis, GraphQL, Node.js, SentinelOne's own platform, and more.

- You enjoy writing modern Java (we love lambdas) and prefer composition to inheritance.

- You're comfortable weighing in on CAP theorem considerations, and are energized by selecting the data structure with the perfect trade-offs for a problem at hand.

- Domain Familiarity

- Experience in the cybersecurity domain is strongly preferred. (think SIEM, EDR/XDR, log pipelines, detection engineering, threat hunting, etc.).

- A Collaborative, Curious, and Practical Mindset

- You're energized by walking into an unfamiliar codebase and being genuinely useful in a week, and by leading others through the same kind of work.

- You believe a vague customer request is an interesting technical problem waiting to be reframed, and that "a problem well-stated is half-solved."

- You can translate between engineers and non-engineers (customers, executives, sales, product, etc.) without losing precision in either direction.

- You'd rather ship a well-thought-out 80% that solves the real problem than a perfect 100% six weeks late. And you can teach others when to customize for one customer versus producing a general solution.

- You take mentorship seriously and enjoy seeing other engineers grow in their ability to solve harder problems.

- You take pride in clear written communication — tickets, design docs, customer runbooks, and executive briefings alike.

As a Staff Security Researcher- Detection AI Research, you will be tasked with joining the Detection AI Research team, where security research meets machine learning.
